moves.text: Lock the lineup before 9:30 AM ET Sunday: Gibbs plays NE in the early international game, and Wilson stays in at WR with Tyson as the 1 PM fallback
moves.why: ESPN has NE vs DET at 9:30 AM ET, three and a half hours before the 1 PM games. ESPN's Sat injury note says Wilson (concussion, Q) is expected to be cleared for BUF; if he still shows up inactive at ~11:30 AM, Jordyn Tyson (8.59, NO vs CAR, 1 PM) is the only WR who can replace him. Kincaid's Q tag is gone, so TE needs no backup this week.

moves.text: Check waivers for a D/ST streamer better than the Vikings @ GB (5.13), and make room by dropping the Bears D/ST, not Mike Evans
moves.why: The Vikings' 5.13 is the lowest projection in the lineup, on the road at Green Bay. The Bears are on bye, so carrying two D/STs wastes a spot this week. Evans is out Week 10 (Achilles) but ESPN lists a Nov 22 return, so he's a Week 11 WR, not dead weight. I disagree with Claude Code's Friday suggestion to drop him. Waiver order is 11 of 12, so this is a free-agent pickup, not a claim.
